EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (Chapter 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My No.: GODS/LND/05/ACQ/39. Land Ministry Reference No.: 4/3/9/2012/WS/193.
I, hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for public purpose:-

Description of the land to be acquired: Allotments of land, depicted as Lot No. 661, 663, 664 in page No. 19 of additional No. 19 in Plan No. A. G. P. 697 prepared by Survey General situated in the village of Masimbula in No. 237, Masimbula Grama Niladari Division in Divisional Secretaries Division of Godakawela in sub division Madapaththuwa, Atakalan Korale, Rathnapura District Sabaragamuwa Province and bounded as follows:
Schedule
01. Lot No. 661 Name of the Land: Kudagodahena; Claimant of the land: Government; Primary Claimant: Mrs. N. M. P. Jinadasa, Kudagodawaththa, Masimbula, Godakawela; Extent: 0.0041 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 663 Name of the Land: Galkotuwa; Claimant of the land: Government; Extent: 0.0129 Hectare.
03. Lot No. 664 Name of the Land: Galkotuwa; Claimant of the land: Government; Extent: 0.0039 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid Lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Godakawela on 18th October 2018 at 9.00 a. m.

And are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 03rd October 2018 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. In order to proof the ownership relevant documents and deeds are submitted on the date of inquiry.
B. S. G. RUWANSIRI, Divisional Secretary, Godakawela. Godakawela Divisional Secretariat, 28th February, 2018 09-830
